headline: Cargo ship bound for Russia hit by drone attack
summary: A cargo vessel headed for Russia was attacked by drones. Kaliningrad is a Russian enclave on the Baltic Sea between Poland and Lithuania that has often been a point of tension.
why: Attacks on shipping in the Baltic affect freight routes, insurance costs and the security risk premium for maritime trade.
original_headline: Buque de carga con destino a Rusia sufre ataque con drones
